notes.title: The Very first Update!
notes.content: [p]Changes:[/p][list][*][p]Changed the lightning in the First few areas as it was too dark![/p][/*][*][p]Added Pop Up in the beginning hinting at the inventory![/p][/*][*][p]Added Weapon Recoil![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Small Bugfixes in the Background.[/p][p][/p][p]I thank everyone who already played the Humble Demo! it is a new journey for me as i never developed before and i am looking forward to what is to come![/p]
